business_problem: Swyfft needed to control rising outside-counsel spend, capture legal expenditures that violated billing guidelines, and free adjusters from manual invoice scrutiny so they could focus on claims and litigation decisions.
solution_summary: Swyfft implemented DXC Assure Legal as the operating system for outside-counsel litigation management, with DXC Assure Legal Insights layered on top for analysis and benchmarking. Legal matter data, invoice details, and guideline exceptions from Swyfft's claims and litigation workflows are brought into the platform so the core application can automate compliance checks, accelerate invoice review, and enforce accountability for partner firms. Assure Legal Insights then exposes the normalized litigation data through dashboards and peer benchmarks, allowing claims and legal teams to compare firms, understand spend patterns, and use empirical evidence to improve outcomes. The source does not name a separate storage tier, but it clearly describes a centralized interface where AI and automation support bill review, compliance analysis, legal-spend transparency, and day-to-day litigation management.

The resulting litigation data is surfaced in DXC Assure Legal Insights dashboards so Swyfft's claims and legal teams can benchmark firms, review spend patterns, and make better case-management decisions.
business_outcome: Swyfft reports better transparency into legal spend, faster invoice review, stronger accountability from partner firms, and a sharp reduction in litigation-management costs, with savings that make the system pay for itself at least twice over.
